Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed two types of MS: an affinity-capture (AC-MS) to find interaction partners and a quantitative proteomic analysis of retinal explants. Per precedence rules, the affinity-purified material (captured by biotinylated peptide on streptavidin beads) defines the sample scope as 'purified protein or complex' (affinity-purified). While Homo sapiens was used in the database search, the actual analyzed material was porcine.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a synthetic peptide (CDR2) as a therapeutic agent. While the peptide is derived from an antibody, it is administered as a synthetic small peptide, mapping it to chemical/drug treatment. No specific inhibitor or activator class from the ontology was a perfect fit, so the parent category was used. The proteomics experiment specifically compared untreated vs 50 ug/mL CDR2 treated retinal explants.
